column1: # FoldX 5.1 -- licensed. Free academic licence from https://foldxsuite.crg.es/
# Download the LINUX X86_64 build. The copy the lab already has is Mac arm64
# and will not run on CoreHPC; the same licence covers both.
# The binary filename encodes its own expiry date, so yours will not match
# anyone else's. Edit the first row to match your download before installing,
# and edit it again when you renew. chpc-tool doctor foldx runs the binary and
# reads its banner, because an expired FoldX is still present, still
# executable, and only says so when it runs.
# molecules/ is a directory and so cannot be a row here; copy it alongside the
# binary if your build ships one.
# columns, tab separated:  filename / sha256 / dest / mode / note
